title: Novel Synthetic Derivative of Renieramycin T Right-Half Analog Induces Apoptosis and Inhibits Cancer Stem Cells via Targeting the Akt Signal in Lung Cancer Cells.
authors: Petsri, Korrakod; Yokoya, Masashi; Racha, Satapat; Thongsom, Sunisa; Thepthanee, Chorpaka; Innets, Bhurichaya; Ei, Zin Zin; Hotta, Daiki; Zou, Hongbin; Chanvorachote, Pithi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型Renieramycin T衍生物通过靶向Akt信号诱导肺癌细胞凋亡并抑制癌症干细胞，属于小分子-蛋白互作与抗癌药理学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Akt is a key regulatory protein of cancer stem cells (CSCs) and is responsible for cancer aggressiveness and metastasis. Targeting Akt is beneficial for the development of cancer drugs. renieramycin T (RT) has been reported to have Mcl-1 targeting activity, and the study of the structure-activity relationships (SARs) demonstrated that cyanide and the benzene ring are essential for its effects. In this study, novel derivatives of the RT right-half analog with cyanide and the modified ring were synthesized to further investigate the SARs for improving the anticancer effects of RT analogs and evaluate CSC-suppressing activity through Akt inhibition. Among the five derivatives, a compound with a substituted thiazole structure (DH_25) exerts the most potent anticancer activity in lung cancer cells. It has the ability to induce apoptosis, which is accompanied by an increase in PARP cleavage, a decrease in Bcl-2, and a diminishment of Mcl-1, suggesting that residual Mcl-1 inhibitory effects exist even after modifying the benzene ring to thiazole. Furthermore, DH_25 is found to induce CSC death, as well as a decrease in CSC marker CD133, CSC transcription factor Nanog, and CSC-related oncoprotein c-Myc. Notably, an upstream member of these proteins, Akt and p-Akt, are also downregulated, indicating that Akt can be a potential target of action. Computational molecular docking showing a high-affinity interaction between DH_25 and an Akt at the allosteric binding site supports that DH_25 can bind and inhibit Akt. This study has revealed a novel SAR and CSC inhibitory effect of DH_25 via Akt inhibition, which may encourage further development of RT compounds for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: Akt是癌症干细胞（CSCs）的关键调控蛋白，负责癌症的侵袭性和转移。靶向Akt有利于抗癌药物的开发。据报道，瑞尼霉素T（RT）具有Mcl-1靶向活性，结构-活性关系（SARs）研究表明，氰基和苯环对其效应至关重要。在本研究中，合成了带有氰基和修饰环的RT右半类似物的新型衍生物，以进一步探讨改善RT类似物抗癌效果的SARs，并评估通过Akt抑制的CSC抑制活性。在五种衍生物中，具有取代噻唑结构的化合物（DH_25）在肺癌细胞中表现出最强的抗癌活性。它具有诱导凋亡的能力，伴随PARP裂解增加、Bcl-2减少和Mcl-1降低，表明即使在将苯环修饰为噻唑后，仍存在残余的Mcl-1抑制效应。此外，发现DH_25能诱导CSC死亡，并降低CSC标志物CD133、CSC转录因子Nanog及CSC相关癌蛋白c-Myc。值得注意的是，这些蛋白的上游成员Akt和p-Akt也被下调，表明Akt可能是其潜在的作用靶点。计算分子对接显示DH_25与Akt在变构结合位点具有高亲和力相互作用，支持DH_25能结合并抑制Akt。本研究揭示了DH_25通过Akt抑制的新型SAR和CSC抑制效应，这可能促进RT化合物在癌症治疗中的进一步开发。
